title: Special Topics in National/International Cinemas; Latin American Cinema
description: Explores the contemporary history of Latin American cinema and the connections between politics and memory from the 1960s to the present and considers the significance of the Cuban Revolution in shaping political filmmaking across Latin America as well as common themes in different national contexts such as revolutions, dictatorship, human rights movements, democratization, neoliberalism, gender roles, and urban and racial inequalities.
